STITCH CALL GRAPH
Per root endpoint, every eligible trace merged into one tree. Each node is `service: operation  [kind]  ×calls per root request`.
─▶ marks a remote call: a client span paired with the server span it caused, shown as one hop. Its client time is the caller's view, server time the callee's, and network+queue their difference.
── marks an in-process child. Times are p50 / p95 in ms; incl is the node's wall time, self subtracts the union of its direct children.
Children are ordered by median start offset.
eligible traces 17/20 (excluded 3: clock_inconsistency 1, duplicate_span_id 1, missing_parent 1)
